## 1.1. Simulation de l'échantillon d'apprentissage (n=1000)

```{r}
set.seed(42)  # pour la reproductibilité

n <- 1000
X <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1)
U <- runif(n, min = 0, max = 1)

Y <- ifelse(X <= 0,
            as.integer(U <= 0.2),
            as.integer(U > 0.4))

# On assemble dans un data frame
data_train <- data.frame(X = X, Y = Y)
head(data_train)
```

```{r}
# Vérification empirique des probabilités conditionnelles
p_neg <- mean(data_train$Y[data_train$X <= 0])
p_pos <- mean(data_train$Y[data_train$X > 0])

cat("P(Y=1 | X<=0) empirique =", round(p_neg, 3), "(théorique = 0.2)\n")
cat("P(Y=1 | X>0)  empirique =", round(p_pos, 3), "(théorique = 0.6)\n")
```

## 1.2. Création d'un second échantillon de taille 200

```{r}
n_test <- 200
X_test <- rnorm(n_test, mean = 0, sd = 1)
U_test <- runif(n_test, min = 0, max = 1)

Y_test <- ifelse(X_test <= 0,
                 as.integer(U_test <= 0.2),
                 as.integer(U_test > 0.4))

data_test <- data.frame(X = X_test, Y = Y_test)
head(data_test)
```
